Position Title: Site Reliability Engineer

Position Summary
We are NimbusScale Technologies, a rapidly growing cloud-native platform provider delivering mission-critical SaaS solutions to enterprise customers. We are hiring an entry-level Site Reliability Engineer to join our Reliability & Platform team. This role is ideal for an early-career engineer who wants hands-on responsibility for operating containerized services, automating CI/CD and infrastructure provisioning, and contributing to a highly available production platform. The role reports to the Lead SRE and works closely with Development, QA, and Product teams to ensure reliability, observability, and smooth deployments for our multi-tenant platform.

Key Responsibilities

Platform Operations and Incident Management
- Monitor, respond to, and resolve production incidents; participate in on-call rotations.
- Triage and diagnose service degradations for containerized workloads; execute runbooks and post-incident reviews.
- Manage service lifecycle tasks including deployments, scaling, and backups to meet SLAs.

Infrastructure Provisioning and Automation
- Implement and maintain infrastructure-as-code to provision and manage environments.
- Collaborate with platform engineers to design repeatable, secure, and auditable infrastructure patterns.
- Automate routine operational tasks to reduce manual toil and improve reliability.

CI/CD and Release Engineering
- Maintain and improve continuous integration and continuous delivery pipelines to enable frequent, safe deployments.
- Work with development teams to standardize build, test, and deployment processes.
- Validate and harden deployment workflows to reduce deployment failures and rollbacks.

Container Orchestration and Platform Management
- Operate and maintain container orchestration clusters for production and non-production environments.
- Manage application deployments, configurations, and resource quotas to optimize cluster utilization.
- Ensure cluster security, networking, and storage integrations meet operational requirements.

Observability, Monitoring, and Performance
- Implement monitoring, alerting, and logging to detect and troubleshoot issues proactively.
- Assist in creating dashboards and alerts to provide actionable insights into system health.
- Participate in capacity planning and performance tuning exercises.

Documentation, Standards and Collaboration
- Create and maintain runbooks, SOPs, and on-call documentation.
- Collaborate cross-functionally to improve service reliability, incident response, and deployment cadence.
- Contribute to engineering best practices around testing, rollback strategies, and security posture.

Required Qualifications

Experience
- 0-2 years

Technical Skills (Mandatory)
- Kubernetes
- Jenkins
- Terraform
- Linux

Other Requirements
- Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills with a pragmatic, customer-focused approach.
- Solid understanding of networking fundamentals, processes, and basic security practices.
- Ability to communicate effectively with engineering and product stakeholders.
- Comfortable working in a fast-paced, collaborative, remote environment.

Preferred Qualifications (Good-to-have)
- AWS
- Prometheus
- GitHub Actions
- Grafana
- Familiarity with container image build tooling and registries.
- Exposure to automated testing and infrastructure testing frameworks.

Success Metrics
- Mean time to detect (MTTD) and mean time to resolve (MTTR) for incidents reduced against baseline within first 6 months.
- Percentage of routine operational tasks automated and documented, measured as reduction in manual toil.
- Deployment success rate and frequency improved as tracked by CI/CD pipeline metrics.
- Health and availability of production clusters meeting target SLAs (uptime and resource utilization).
- Timely completion and accuracy of runbooks, incident reviews, and platform onboarding for new services.

Location and Work Mode
- Fully remote within India.
